title: Tesla's Cybercab Incurs Monthly Fees and Resale Limits
excerpt: Tesla's upcoming $30,000 Cybercab features a $299 monthly subscription fee along with restrictions on driving locations and vehicle resale.
body_html:
Tesla plans to price its upcoming Cybercab at $30,000, but the vehicle comes with additional ongoing costs and usage restrictions for buyers. According to details, owners will face a $299 monthly fee in order to use the vehicle.

Additionally, the company maintains control over the vehicle's operations through software. Tesla holds the ability to restrict the geographic areas where the Cybercab is permitted to drive. Furthermore, the manufacturer can block vehicle owners from reselling the cars.
